_comment: A structurally valid plan whose claimed numbers DON'T add up to its own listed food — the case ADR-015 decision 9 and section 11 exist for (mirrors V56__excel_diet_plan.sql's real, seeded drift). Real catalog ids/amounts (chicken 200g + rice 80g + vegetables serving (300g) + olive-oil serving (10g), all from V22/V25/V49) actually sum to 703 kcal / 57.6 g protein / 81.2 g carbs / 15.7 g fat -- hand-computed from the seeded per-100g values: chicken 110/23/0/2 x2, rice 360/7/79/1 x0.8, vegetables 35/2/6/0.3 x3, olive-oil 900/0/0/100 x0.1. The claimed day target below (1100/100/150/40) is picked to overclaim by roughly the same 379-702 kcal magnitude V56 drifted by. PlanAgentAdapter must parse this and preserve the claimed 1100/100/150/40 verbatim (ADR-015 decision 9: never silently corrected) -- slice 6 hands the parsed plan to PlanToleranceAuditor, which is expected to report EXCEEDS_TOLERANCE on every one of the four day-level metrics.

plan.name: Día de prueba con desviación
plan.description: Un único día, para que slice 6 tenga un caso real de desviación al auditar tolerancias (ADR-015 sección 11).

days.notes: El agente afirma 1100 kcal / 100 g proteína / 150 g carbohidratos / 40 g grasa; la comida que lista suma 703 / 57.6 / 81.2 / 15.7.
